description: Cross-language contract fixture for the deviation monitor (FORK.md §57). The web UI sends run context[context_key] only while the chat's monitor is on, exactly one of run_context_examples' shape, and omits the key otherwise; absent means off and the backend writes nothing. The Gateway stores the canonical form (deerflow/config/deviation_monitor_config.py). The middleware writes thread-state channel state_channel with exactly state_keys plus state_extra_keys, whose status is one of statuses; run_start_state is its run-start write (on_track with last_checked_step null: no check has run in this run yet, which the status bar shows as watching). A confirmed drift rewrites the checked response in place (same id): tool calls removed, the note appended to content, additional_kwargs[action_marker_key] set, and the run stamped with stop_reason. stopped_message and stopped_state are what the backend emits for request and the scripted verdict in judge_reply; backend/tests/test_deviation_monitor.py regenerates them, and the frontend unit tests and tests/e2e/deviation-monitor.spec.ts read them. GET /api/features carries {feature_key: {"enabled": bool}}.
